verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own playgrounds and offline evals let users test prompts, models and scorers against curated or inline datasets, separate from live production traffic. CI-integrated experiments are positioned as catching regressions before they reach production. However, nothing documents a dedicated sandbox environment or isolation guarantee, and datasets are often built from production logs. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or staging environment, documented isolation from production data, separate test-vs-prod projects or keys, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Playgrounds provide a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets.
integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production
Datasets are versioned collections of test cases that you use to run evaluations and track improvements over time.
